inUse.booking: Table {number} has a booking still to come.

errors.inUseHint: Settle the bill or move the booking, then save again. Or keep the table for now.
errors.inUseHintDisable: Settle the bill or move the booking first, then take it out of service.

areaDialog.description: A floor, a terrace, a private room: wherever staff go to serve.

removeArea.title: Remove {area}?

tables.one: Its table ({list}) comes off the plan too.
tables.other: Its {count} tables ({list}) come off the plan too.

tableDialog.editDescription: Its number is the one on its QR code: reprint it if you change the number.

taken.one: Table {list} is already on the plan
taken.other: Tables {list} are already on the plan

tableDialog.takenOne: Table {number} is already on the plan
tableDialog.qrNote: Its QR code stops working once you save.
tableDialog.serviceOn: Guests can scan its QR code and order; it can be booked.
tableDialog.serviceOff: Out of service: kept on the plan with its number and QR code, but nobody can order or book it.

load.errorBody: Check the connection and try again.

save.summary: Changes apply for guests as soon as you save.
save.failed: Your changes weren't saved. Try again.
save.leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?

errors.phoneRegion: Use a number starting {dialCode}, this branch's country code

errors.instagramUrl: Use your Instagram link, e.g. https://instagram.com/yourname
errors.facebookUrl: Use your Facebook link, e.g. https://facebook.com/yourpage

errors.xUrl: Use your X link, e.g. https://x.com/yourname
errors.whatsappUrl: Use a WhatsApp link, e.g. https://wa.me/919876543210
errors.googleReviewsUrl: Use your Google review link, e.g. https://g.page/r/…/review
errors.faqQuestion: Each question needs words, up to 120 characters
errors.faqAnswer: Each question needs an answer, up to 1000 characters
errors.orderPrefix: Use 1 to 5 capital letters, e.g. BLR
errors.taxId: This number doesn't look right. Check it against your registration.
errors.orderStart: Use a whole number from 1 to 999999
errors.image: This photo can't be used. Upload it again.
errors.noOpenDay: Open the branch on at least one day.
errors.lastOrders: Each session must be longer than the last-orders time.
errors.taxRate: Use a rate from 0 to 50%, with up to two decimals.
errors.serviceRate: Use a service charge from 0.01 to 30%.
errors.taxLines: The taxes changed meanwhile. Discard and try again.
errors.noMethods: Offer at least one payment method here.
errors.unknownMethod: A payment method isn't available at this branch.
errors.recommended: The method marked Fastest must be offered.
errors.noAtTable: Accept at least one way to pay the printed bill.
errors.noZones: Add a delivery zone, or switch delivery off.
errors.noAreas: Add at least one area this zone covers.

errors.money: Use an amount of 0 or more, with up to two decimals.

errors.eta: Time to the door is 5 to 240 minutes.
errors.distance: Distance is 1 to 100 km, or leave it empty.

errors.lastBranch: This is your only branch. Add another branch before removing it.
errors.branchInUse: This branch has orders today still to finish or pay. Settle them, then remove it.

errors.locale: Choose how numbers and times are written.
errors.noService: Keep at least one way to order switched on.
errors.deliveryNeedsZones: Add a delivery zone before switching delivery on.
errors.sessionTime: Give each session an opening and a closing time.
errors.sessionOverlap: Sessions can't overlap, including one running past midnight into the next day's first.
errors.tooManySessions: Keep it to 4 sessions a day.
errors.sessionLabel: Keep each session name to 30 characters.
errors.specialDates: Give each special date a real start and end date: the end on or after the start, up to 62 days.
errors.specialLabel: Keep each special date's name to 40 characters.

help.subtitle: What guests see on the Help page. Anything left empty isn't shown to them.
help.wifiHintCard: Guests seated at a table see the name and password, with a button to copy the password.
help.wifiPasswordHint: Optional. Only guests seated at a table see it.
help.socialHint: Shared by all your branches. Paste a link, or leave it empty to hide that icon.
help.openLabel: Open the {network} link in a new tab
help.faqsHint: Shown under “Allergens & FAQs”. Opening hours and the address are added for you from this branch's settings.
help.question: Question
help.answerPlaceholder: e.g. Yes, free parking behind the building.

details.subtitle: Who and where this branch is. Guests see these on the start screen, the welcome screen and the Help page.
details.aboutHint: The name guests see, and how staff tell branches apart.
details.name: Name
details.shortNameHint: The area or neighbourhood: shown in the branch picker and on the start screen.
details.addressHint: The map link guests open is made from it.
details.photoHint: Shown on the branch picker and to guests choosing an outlet. Without one, the short name's first letter is shown.
details.photoFileHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. A square photo looks best; it's resized before uploading.
details.photoFailed: We couldn't upload that image. Try another one.
details.guestsHint: Leave it empty and guests aren't shown it.
details.wifiHint: Shown when a guest's phone goes offline.
details.wifiMoved: The guest Wi-Fi, social media links and FAQs are on Settings › Help page.
details.ordersHint: How orders at this branch are numbered on receipts, tickets and guests' phones. Each order also gets a token that starts at 1 every day.
details.orderPrefixHint: 1 to 5 capital letters, e.g. the area's initials.
details.orderStartHint: A new prefix starts here. Numbers already used are never given again.
details.orderExample: The next order with a new prefix looks like {example}.
details.regionHint: Prices, times and phone numbers follow these.
details.localeHint: How numbers, prices and times are written. Example: {example}
details.timezoneHint: Today's hours, orders and reports follow it. Local time now: {time}
details.countryChanged: Moving the branch to {country} switches its phone number rules, taxes and payment methods to {country}'s when you save. Check Tax & service charge and Payment methods afterwards; delivery areas stay as they are.
details.currencyChanged: Menu prices keep their numbers in the new currency. Change them on the Menu page if they should be converted.
details.timezoneSearch: Type a city or region to find it, e.g. Kathmandu.

hours.subtitle: When this branch takes orders. A day can have several sessions, such as lunch and dinner, and a session can run past midnight. Outside them, and from last orders, guests see the branch as closed until the next session.
hours.weekHint: Each day's sessions, in the branch's local time. A day without any is closed.
hours.closedNote: Staff can still pause, close for the day or open late from the bar at the top of every admin page.
hours.lastOrdersHint: Orders stop this long before each session closes. Seated guests can still ask for the bill and pay.
hours.modesHint: Each follows the opening hours, unless you give it hours of its own (delivering later than the dining room, say).
hours.specialHint: Holidays and festivals: close for the day, or open in other sessions. They replace the week for every way of ordering.

tax.subtitle: How this branch's bills are worked out. New bills use these straight away.
tax.taxesHint: Your region's taxes. Change a rate when the law changes.
tax.chargeHint: Switch off if this branch isn't registered for {tax}.
tax.chargeOn: Bills add {tax} at the rates below.
tax.chargeOff: Bills have no {tax} and are titled "{title}". Your rates are kept for when you switch it back on.

taxIdHints.gstin: 15 characters, e.g. 29ABCDE1234F1Z5. Printed on bills; leave empty if you don't have one.
taxIdHints.pan: 9 digits. Printed on bills; leave empty if you don't have one.
taxIdHints.taxId: Printed on bills; leave empty if you don't have one.

tax.serviceHint: Added to the item total before tax.
tax.serviceOnHint: Every bill shows the service charge as its own line.
tax.serviceOffHint: Bills don't show a service charge.
tax.discountBeforeTaxOn: Offers and promo codes lower the amount taxes are worked out on.
tax.discountBeforeTaxOff: Taxes are worked out on the full item total, then discounts come off.
tax.roundTotal: Round the total to a whole {symbol}
tax.exampleHint: For items worth {amount}, with what you've set.
tax.note: Orders already placed keep the rates they were priced with.

payments.subtitle: How guests can pay at this branch, screen by screen. Methods are shown in the order you set.

checkout.title: Dine-in checkout
checkout.hint: When a guest at a table places an order.

bill.title: Pay my bill
bill.hint: When a guest pays their bill in the app. Online methods only.

takeaway.title: Takeaway
takeaway.hint: When a guest orders to collect. A pay-later method is paid on pickup.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.hint: When a guest orders delivery. A pay-later method is paid to the rider.

modeOff.takeaway: Takeaway is off at this branch, so guests don't see these now.
modeOff.delivery: Delivery is off at this branch, so guests don't see these now.

atTable.title: Paying the printed bill
atTable.hint: Ways staff accept at the table. The bill and the Help page name them in this order.

delivery.subtitle: Where this branch delivers and what it costs. Guests pick their area at checkout.
delivery.prepHint: Before the rider leaves with the order.
delivery.feeTaxableOn: The fee is taxed like the items.
delivery.feeTaxableOff: The fee is added after tax.
delivery.zonesHint: Each zone's areas, fee and minimum order. An area can be in one zone only.
delivery.noZones: No delivery zones yet. Add one so guests can choose their area.
delivery.removeBody: Guests in {areas} can't order delivery any more once you save.

zoneDialog.description: Guests in these areas pay this fee and order at least this much.
zoneDialog.name: Zone name
zoneDialog.areasHint: One per line, or separated by commas. Guests pick from these.
zoneDialog.freeAboveHint: Free delivery once the items reach this.

pickup.subtitle: Takeaway at this branch: guests order ahead and collect at the counter.
pickup.prepHint: "As soon as possible" is ready this long after ordering.
pickup.slotsHint: Times guests can choose, counted from opening time until closing.
pickup.asapOn: Guests can collect as soon as it's ready, as well as at a slot.
pickup.previewHint: What a guest ordering now would see. Open today {hours}.

branches.subtitle: The branches you manage. You always keep at least one.
branches.onlyOne: This is your only branch. You can add more, but there must always be at least one.
branches.removeOnly: {branch} is your only branch and can't be removed
branches.added: {branch} added. Switch to it to set it up.
branches.removeBody: {branch} leaves the start screen and the branch picker: guests can't order there and staff can't open it.
branches.removeCurrent: You're working in it now, so you'll move to {next}.
branches.removeFailed: The branch wasn't removed. Try again.

addBranch.title: Add a branch
addBranch.description: It starts as a copy of a branch you have: region, taxes, payments, hours, delivery, pickup, menu and floor plan. Change any of them in Settings.
addBranch.copyFromHint: Its country, currency and time zone carry over.
addBranch.failed: The branch wasn't added. Try again.
addBranch.countryHint: Its time zone, currency, phone rules, taxes and payment methods follow the country.

services.subtitle: The ways guests can order at this branch. Keep at least one on.
services.cardHint: Guests only see the ones that are on, on the start screen and on QR codes.

dineIn.label: Dine-in
dineIn.on: Guests scan the table's QR code and order at the table; waiters take orders too.
dineIn.off: Table QR codes open the start screen instead, and waiters can't take table orders.

takeaway.label: Takeaway
takeaway.on: Guests order ahead and collect at the counter.
takeaway.off: Guests can't order takeaway from this branch.

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.on: Guests in your delivery zones can order delivery.
delivery.off: Guests can't order delivery from this branch.

services.managedHere: {mode} is {state}. Switch it on or off on the Overview tab.
services.afterCardHint: What guests can do with an order once they have placed it.

guestChanges.label: Guests can change or cancel
guestChanges.on: For {minutes} after placing an order, until the kitchen starts on it. Staff can always change or cancel.
guestChanges.off: Only staff can change or cancel orders. Guests see their order without these options.

offers.subtitle: Automatic discounts guests get without a code, such as happy hour. Each runs on its days and hours (branch time), within its dates if you set them, for the ways of ordering you choose. Prices on the menu, in the cart and on the bill follow at once.
offers.empty: No offers yet. Add one, such as a happy hour on drinks.
offers.saveFailed: Couldn't save the offer. Try again.
offers.scopeUnknown: Some dishes or categories are no longer on the menu. Check what it covers.
offers.removeBody: Guests stop getting it at once. Orders that already had it keep it on their bills.

dialog.description: Times and dates are the branch's local time.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameHint: Guests see it on the menu and the bill.
dialog.activeHint: Paused offers stay here but never apply.
dialog.timeHint: Ends before it starts? It runs past midnight.
dialog.datesHint: Optional. Leave empty to run with no end.
dialog.coversHint: Whole categories, single dishes, or both.
dialog.dishSearchPlaceholder: Type a dish name, e.g. lassi
dialog.noMatches: No dish matches. Dishes in a picked category are already covered.

errors.name: Give it a name (up to 40 characters).
errors.sameTime: It can't end when it starts.
errors.dates: The last day can't be before the first.
errors.modes: Pick at least one way of ordering.
errors.scope: Pick at least one category or dish.

roles.subtitle: Each role is a set of permissions. Give staff a role and they can do exactly that, at every branch they work at.
roles.failed: Couldn't load the roles. Try again.
roles.builtInHint: Built-in roles stay as they are. Duplicate one to make your own version.
roles.removeBody: Nobody has this role. It will be gone for good.

inUse.one: {count} staff member still has this role. Give them another role first.
inUse.other: {count} staff still have this role. Give them another role first.

roles.forbidden: You can only give permissions you have yourself.
roles.saveFailed: Couldn't save the role. Try again.

dialog.name: Role name
dialog.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Runs the kitchen and the stock
dialog.neededBy: Needed for: {names}. Stays on while they are.

orders_view.label: See orders and tables
orders_view.hint: Today's orders, the floor plan and guests' requests.

orders_take.label: Take orders
orders_take.hint: New orders and rounds at a table; change a round before cooking.

service_respond.label: Answer guests
service_respond.hint: Waiter calls and bill requests; mark food served.

payments_collect.label: Collect payments
payments_collect.hint: Cash, card or UPI at the table or counter.

cash_manage.label: Run the cash register
cash_manage.hint: Open and close the drawer, count it, pay cash in and out.

cash_review.label: Review cash and sign off
cash_review.hint: Day-end summary, reports, the difference limit and signing off each day.

kitchen_update.label: Run the kitchen
kitchen_update.hint: Start, ready and out of stock on kitchen tickets.

menu_availability_update.label: Mark dishes sold out
menu_availability_update.hint: Take a dish off the menu, or put it back.

orders_cancel.label: Cancel orders
orders_cancel.hint: Cancel whole orders. Anything paid is refunded.

refunds_give.label: Give refunds
refunds_give.hint: Give money back, and mark online refunds as received.

reservations_manage.label: Manage bookings
reservations_manage.hint: Take, change, seat and cancel reservations.

menu_manage.label: Edit the menu
menu_manage.hint: Add, change and remove dishes and categories.

tables_manage.label: Edit tables
tables_manage.hint: The floor plan and table QR codes.

branches_manage.label: Add and remove branches
branches_manage.hint: Open new branches or remove one.

staff_manage.label: Manage staff and roles
staff_manage.hint: Add staff, give them roles, create roles.

inventory_view.label: See stock
inventory_view.hint: Stock levels, the ledger and low-stock alerts.

inventory_manage.label: Manage inventory
inventory_manage.hint: Ingredients, opening stock, reorder levels and costs.

inventory_adjust.label: Adjust stock
inventory_adjust.hint: Correct stock up or down, with a reason.

inventory_wastage.label: Record wastage
inventory_wastage.hint: Record what was thrown away, and why.

inventory_count.label: Count stock
inventory_count.hint: Count what's on the shelves, without seeing what the system expects. A manager applies the count.

purchase_view.label: See purchasing
purchase_view.hint: Suppliers, purchase orders, deliveries and returns.

purchase_manage.label: Buy
purchase_manage.hint: Suppliers; create and send orders; record deliveries and returns; confirm prices.

purchase_approve.label: Approve orders
purchase_approve.hint: Approve orders above the limit, and set it.

purchase_receive.label: Receive deliveries
purchase_receive.hint: Record what came at the door, without prices.

staff.subtitle: Everyone who works at {branch}, and your restaurant admins. Add people, give them a role, or turn their sign-in off.
staff.failed: Couldn't load the staff. Try again.

errors.emailExists: Someone with this email is already on the staff here.
errors.phoneTaken: This mobile number belongs to someone else.
errors.ownAccount: You can't change your own role or turn off your own sign-in.
errors.lastAdmin: Your restaurant needs at least one active admin.
errors.forbidden: You can only give roles whose permissions you have yourself.

dialog.name: Full name
dialog.passwordHint: Share it with them. They choose their own the first time they sign in.
dialog.activeOn: They can sign in and work here.
dialog.activeOff: They can't sign in. Turning this off signs them out at once.
dialog.youNote: You can change your name here. Ask another admin to change your role.

reset.title: New password for {name}
reset.body: They're signed out everywhere now, and choose their own password the next time they sign in.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Optional parts of the app this restaurant uses. Each one is on or off for all its branches.
features.inventoryOn: On for every branch: stock, recipes, suppliers, deliveries.
features.inventoryOff: Off: the restaurant works without stock, as before. Its data is kept.
features.who: Only the platform team can change this.
features.turnedOff: Inventory is off. Dishes stock had taken off are back on the menu.
